newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - lira, dollar, mark and yen.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - lira, dollar, mark and yen.

text.p: trade ideas focused on Eurolire, dollars, marks, yen and
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY Over the last month EIB has outperformed Helaba

by approximately 30 basis points in price terms. Helaba offers good value as it is cheap against the swap and the BTP (trading respectively at around three b.p. through and three b.p. over) and represents around an 18 b.p. pick up in yield.
STRATEGY Dresdner Bank is currently expensive against

the swap, trading at around 29 b.p. through. Bayerische Hypothekenbank is attractive as it offers a 24 b.p. pick up in yield for a small change in duration. It also allows the investor to buy a bond trading below par.
STRATEGY EIB over the last month has outperformed KFW

approximately 95 b.p. in price terms. KfW is attractive as it is cheap against the swap (around 14 b.p. through) and the Btp (around nine b.p. through). KfW offers a 19 b.p. pick up in yield and trades on a bid/offer spread of 25 b.p.
STRATEGY Over the past month Eurofima's 8.375 pct 2004
has outperformed its 7.70 pct 2003 by approximately 50 b.p. in price terms.

The Eurofima 8.375 pct is expensive against the swap (around 22 b.p. through) and the BTP (around 37 b.p. through) while the 7.70 pct offers good value. Investors can pick 15 b.p. in yield by lengthening duration by four months.
STRATEGY Over the past month this has underperformed

other bonds in the same area by around 65 b.p. It is cheap for a supranational trading at around one b.p. through the swap (on the offer side) and at around 10 b.p. through the BTP (on the offer side). The 25 b.p. bid/offer indicates good liquidity.
STRATEGY This has underperformed other bonds in the same
area by around 90 b.p. in price terms. It is cheap against the swap (around two b.p. over) and the BTP (trading around nine b.p. through). This bond also offers good liquidity.
STRATEGY This trade offers an improved credit rating
(from AA1/AA+ to AA1/AAA) and gives a yield pick up of around four b.p. as well as a cash pick up.
STRATEGY These two bonds have underperformed the market

recently on the basis of their association with the troubled BankGesellschaft Berlin. They say that to assess the bonds on this basis is wrong as the ultimate credit risk on these bonds is actually that of Landesbank Berlin. On this basis they believe the 6.625 percent 1999's to be about 10 b.p. cheap and the 6.50 percent 2001's to be about five b.p. cheap.
STRATEGY This bond is around four b.p. through, using
the BOBL 119 benchmark, verses the swap. This makes it good value when compared to the EIB 5.125 pct 12/01 bond of the same rating which is currently trading at around 36 b.p. through.
STRATEGY This gives a yield pick-up of around 10 b.p.
Given the current uncertainty in the market and the past week's shortening the EIB issue has become expensive.
